value.policy: During active training retain only the most recently completed named checkpoint. It includes model, optimizer and three-rank RNG. Retire older completed epochs and the byte-identical latest alias.
value.after_training: Retain the final checkpoint until complete same-protocol evaluation and diagnosis; then preserve only the best measured method checkpoint across completed candidates.
value.reference_and_initialization_inputs: Outside this cleanup scope and retained.

value.wallclock_scope: Includes original evaluation, observed directory failure, diagnosis gap and recovery; per-frame inference timing remains in coverage.

actual_due_observation.scope: Read the existing pipeline stage and its own receipts. Completed training ranks may normally be absent during CPU audit/evaluation. No model load, replay, restart, hardware query/control or deletion.

next_observer_receipt.scope: One due read using measured reference LasHeR physical-GPU shard times plus six-minute margin. No interim log, native-session, remote-progress or hardware query; no job launch/restart.

next_estimate.scope: Same fixed LasHeR sequence order, image pairing and three shard assignments. Sum measured author-reference synchronized image-read/preprocess/track seconds per physical GPU; use slowest shard plus six minutes for startup/scoring/variation. Not a measurement of method speed, current completed frames, or all-three-suite completion.

recovery_historical_field_issue.cause: Receipt stores reference['completed_datasets'] by list reference; appending completed DepthTrack also changes the historical label. Archived original failure and initial snapshot retain the original two-dataset value.
recovery_historical_field_issue.action: Record observed metadata issue; do not rewrite the active worker receipt or restart its controller.

interpretation: All three measured author-reference benchmarks now collected. Method remains in first dataset, not a benchmark improvement. Same-protocol reference versus extra fine-tuning has unequal total training budget; fair optimizer/module controls remain required.
